definitions.explanation: To replace an old roof covering with a new one, tearing off worn tiles or thatch and reinstalling fresh material. A regular maintenance task for traditional tiled or thatched roofs.

examples.japanese: ⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{葺|ふ}き{替|か}える。
⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{傷|いた}んだ→傷む：10061_itamu⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{葺|ふ}き⟦{替|か}えた→替える：13399_kaeru⟧。
examples.english: They re-roofed the house that had been damaged by the typhoon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{茅葺|かやぶ}き→茅葺き：27791_kayabuki⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{二十|にじゅう}→二十：00975_nijuu⟧〜⟦{三十|さんじゅう}→三十：00984_sanjuu⟧⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧ごとに{葺|ふ}き{替|か}える⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧がある。
examples.english: A thatched roof needs to be re-thatched every twenty to thirty years.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- Pattern: ⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{葺|ふ}き{替|か}える

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{瓦|かわら}→瓦：03902_kawara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{葺|ふ}き{替|か}える: to replace roof tiles
- ⟦{茅葺|かやぶ}き→茅葺き：27791_kayabuki⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{葺|ふ}き{替|か}える: to re-thatch a thatched roof

USAGE:
Built from ⟦{葺|ふ}く→葺く：30860_fuku⟧ (to tile/thatch) + ⟦{替|か}える→替える：13399_kaeru⟧ (to replace); the compound specifically means removing an existing covering and installing a new one, not tiling a roof for the first time.
